description: Template-filled sentence naming the concrete signals that put a game on the case-study list, using fixed templates over stored numeric fields only -- no free-form generated prose, so every rendered claim traces back to a stored value.
signature: def build_rationale(row: pd.Series, archetype_label: str) -> str
docstring:
Build one case study's rationale sentence.

Args:
    row: A single games_enriched row (as a Series) for the case study's appid.
    archetype_label: The game's assigned cluster's label.

Returns:
    A single sentence assembled from a fixed template, naming: review volume (review_count), positivity (review_positive_pct), price (price_usd), install size (size_bytes, rendered in MB/GB), and developer catalog size (dev_title_count), plus the archetype_label. Uses hedged wording ONLY: 'plausibly small in scope', 'appears compact', 'signals suggest' -- NEVER 'took two weeks to build' or any unhedged development-time/cost claim, per ARCHITECTURE.md limitation 3 and the module's own invariant.

Example: "With {review_count:,} reviews ({review_positive_pct:.0%} positive) at ${price_usd:.2f}, this {archetype_label} title's {size_bytes} install size and single prior release from its developer suggest a plausibly small development scope."
preconditions: row has all five referenced fields present (NaN is handled per-field, not assumed absent -- see edge cases)
postconditions: The output contains no phrase from a forbidden-phrase list (e.g. 'took X weeks', 'cost $X to make', 'developed in X months') -- verified by reporting's own tests via a fixed regex/substring check
Every concrete number appearing in the sentence is read directly from row, never fabricated or estimated within this function

edge_cases.expected_behavior: that clause is omitted from the sentence entirely rather than rendering 'nan' or a placeholder

unit_tests.name: test_rationale_contains_stored_signals
unit_tests.description: A fully populated fixture row's rationale contains the exact review_count, price and archetype_label values, per the module's own testing requirement.
unit_tests.expected: sentence contains the row's own review_count, price_usd and archetype_label

unit_tests.name: test_rationale_contains_no_unhedged_effort_claim
unit_tests.description: The output is checked against a forbidden-phrase list and contains none of them, per the module's own testing requirement.

unit_tests.name: test_missing_dev_title_count_omits_clause
unit_tests.description: dev_title_count=NaN omits that clause without leaving a dangling 'nan' string.
